title: مِيمُ الْجَمْعِ I
description: Rules regarding the ṣilah on the mīm al-jamʿ. Mīm al-jamʿ refers to the mīm sākinah of the plural masculine second and third person pronouns i.e., هم and كُـمْ and تُمْ. Ṣilah refers to the stretching of the ḍammah until it becomes wāw maddah and/or stretching the kasrah until it becomes yāʾ maddah. In both cases it will be read in the state of waṣl and omitted if waqf is made on it.

no_silah_when_followed_by_sakin.title: No ṣilah when followed by sakin
no_silah_when_followed_by_sakin.description: When the mīm al-jamʿ is followed by a sakin letter, no ṣilah will be made by any of the qurra.

silah_when_followed_by_pronoun.title: Ṣilah when followed by another pronoun
silah_when_followed_by_pronoun.description: When the mīm al-jamʿ is followed by another pronoun, ṣilah will be made by all of the qurra.

silah_when_followed_by_mutharrik.title: Ṣilah when followed by a mutaḥarrikah letter
silah_when_followed_by_mutharrik.description: Read the mīm al-jamʿ with ṣilah when it is followed by a letter that carries a vowel (ie mutaḥarrikah letter).
exceptions: The ṣilah on mīm al-jamʿ when it is followed by a mutaḥarrikah letter for Imam Warsh is ONLY when that letter is a ء (hamzah). He will not make ṣilah on the mīm al-jamʿ in any other case.
silah_when_followed_by_mutharrik.note: Imam Qalun will recite the ṣilah with qaṣr or madd and Imam Warsh with ṭūl when the mutaḥarrikah letter is ء according to their rules of madd

examples.verse: examples of mīm al-jamʿ followed by mutaḥarrikah
examples.note: note the mutaḥarrikah letter after mīm al-jam. Since the mutaḥarrikah is not a ء (hamzah), ṣilah is only made for Imams Ibn Kathir and one of Imam Qalun's options.

examples.verse: examples of mīm al-jamʿ followed by mutaḥarrikah
examples.note: and in this case because the mutaḥarrikah is a hamzah, Imams Ibn Kathir, Qalun (one option) AND Warsh will make the ṣilah

no_silah_when_followed_by_mutharrik.title: No ṣilah when followed by a mutaḥarrikah letter
no_silah_when_followed_by_mutharrik.description: There will be no ṣilah even when the following letter is mutaḥarrikah.
exceptions: Imam Warsh does make ṣilah when the mutaḥarrikah letter is a ء (hamzah).
no_silah_when_followed_by_mutharrik.note: Note that this is one of Imam Qalun's options (with the other being to make ṣilah).
